The first release of **Spectra**: a private Android food diary that tracks every nutrient, label first.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.0/Spectra.apk)** · [Website and how-tos](https://m0n0t0ne0ne.github.io/spectra/) · [Privacy](https://m0n0t0ne0ne.github.io/spectra/privacy.html)

### Highlights
- **Diary** with a live summary: energy vs. target (workouts added automatically), burned, deficit or surplus, macros, nutrient score and trend bars.
- **Custom meals**: add, rename, reorder and delete; swipe menus; long-press to reorder foods.
- **Find any food**: your foods, USDA and barcodes in one search; a careful scanner; Ask Gemini for products no database has.
- **Sourced values**: every nutrient tagged Label, Spec, Lab or est.; small amounts never rounded to zero.
- **Preview edits**: numbers update as you change a portion; nothing is saved until you tap Save.
- **Report and Insights**: DRIs for your age, sex and life stage; weight outlook, goal adherence, nutrient gaps, omega-6 : omega-3 ratio, limits, and foods to add or cut.
- **Your data**: on the phone only, excluded from Android backup; export or import any day, month, year or range; storage manager.

### Install
Android 10 or newer. Download `Spectra.apk`, open it, and allow installing from your browser or Files app if asked. Spectra installs as a new app; to bring over data from the "Nutrients" test builds, export there and import in Spectra.
